text: Teaching Objective The program is committed to train students to become applied engineering and technical talented professionals with a sound theoretic foundation, systematical knowledge and skill of the capability to carry out the scientific research, system analysis, system design, technical development, and management in the field of computer science and technology and capability of engineering practice in computer software and hardware development and application in science research departments, education institution, enterprises, technical and administrative departments.Duration4 academic yearsDegree Awarded Bachelor of Engineering
